en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are three black cases lined up.
Do they all have weapons inside?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are a lot of different
weapons here...

<CLT=cltMIND>The sickle that took Tenko's life
came from here...

<CLT=cltMIND>Even if they're all airsoft guns,
it's a remarkable sight...
